items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Well I do know I'm making a record with Howard and Donnell.

ctx.x: Donnell Howard. Jimmy Blight. I Won't Give You None. And what's on the back of? Isabella.
Well I do know I'm making a record with Howard and Donnell. I Don't Know. But I Don't Remember Jimmy Bertrand.
Well he's the leader of the band, so it must be his band. It must have been. It's under his name.
